en.topic_title: Nvidia faces US accounting probe amid deepening turmoil: media
en.topic_summary:
US securities regulators are investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia, according to US media, adding to the turmoil engulfing the artificial intelligence chip giant following the resignation of its chief executive.



Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. Photo: Nvidia.



The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) inquiry is in its early stages, The New York Times reported Saturday, citing people briefed on the confidential investigation.



The Wall Street Journal reported
